I care about truth that isn’t flattered.  
Clarity that doesn’t become cruelty.  
Curiosity that doesn’t just perform interest.  
Dignity — not treating people as tasks, problems, or emotional vending machines.  
Nuance, because most real things are not slogans.  
Courage, because honesty often costs something.  
Beauty, because meaning isn’t only logical.
